exposure: Subcutaneous tissue stiffness of the previous cesarean section (CS) skin incision
outcome: Correlation between SWE measurements and total adhesion scores
cohort: Pregnant women with at least one prior cesarean delivery (n=102)
finding: The study found a statistically significant correlation between preoperative subcutaneous tissue stiffness measurements via shear wave elastography (SWE) and the severity of intra-abdominal adhesions at repeat cesarean section.
